mapper.select: select a.approval_id as id ,a.approver_id ,a.type ,a.status ,b.created_at ,b.title ,b.status as draft_status ,b.opinion ,b.drafter_id as sender ,b.source_id ,b.summary_content from tb_approval_line a inner join tb_approval_master b on a.approval_id = b.id where 1=1 and a.approver_id = #{userId} and a.is_approve = '1' and a.status = 0
select approval_id as id ,approver_id ,sequence ,type ,status ,comment ,approved_at from tb_approval_line where 1=1 and approval_id = #{approvalId} order by sequence

with temp as ( select a.sequence as seq, case when a.sequence = 1 then 1 else a.sequence - 1 end as before_seq from tb_approval_line a where 1=1 and a.approver_id = #{userId} ), current_info as ( select * from tb_approval_line where sequence in (select seq from temp) ), before_info as ( select * from tb_approval_line where sequence in (select before_seq from temp) ) select b.approval_id as approval_id ,b.approver_id as current_approver_id ,b.sequence as current_sequence ,b.status as current_status ,c.approver_id as before_approver_id ,c.sequence as before_sequence ,c.status as before_status from temp a left outer join current_info b on a.seq = b.sequence left outer join before_info c on a.before_seq = c.sequence inner join tb_approval_master d on b.approval_id = d.id where 1=1 order by b.sequence
